settings.content: The three blues come straight from the logo's stripes. They also stand for graduated compression: royal is firmest (ankle), sky is easing (calf), ice is lightest (knee).

settings.label: Logo for light backgrounds
settings.info: Leave empty to use the logo bundled with the theme.

settings.label: White logo for coloured backgrounds
settings.info: Used over the homepage carousel. Leave empty to use the bundled white logo.

settings.label: Favicon
settings.info: Square .png, at least 96 × 96px. Leave empty to use the bundled icon.

settings.content: Shown in the footer's legal strip on every page. The name, VAT number, address, email and phone also go into search-engine structured data. South African online stores must show these details (ECTA, section 43).

settings.label: Practice website
settings.info: Linked from the founder section and listed in structured data.

settings.label: Founder profile page
settings.info: The page about the founder, for example on the practice website. Used in search-engine structured data.

settings.label: Other founder profiles
settings.info: One verified profile URL per line. Used in search-engine structured data.

settings.label: Compression reference product
settings.info: Wherever copy contains [compression], it shows this product's custom.compression_level metafield (e.g. 18–21 mmHg). If the metafield is blank, the paragraph, point, feature or question holding [compression] is hidden.

settings.label: Notice above the checkout button
settings.info: Shown in the cart drawer and on the cart page. "Terms of service", "Shipping" and "Refund" link to those policies when they exist.
settings.default: By checking out, you agree to our Terms of service, including the health and suitability and liability sections, and our Shipping and Refund policies.
